scope: Initial Owner approval native read-only exact saved-plan revalidation; no approval writes or tokens activated
requirements: New optional plan_path is a closed opaque-control field, returned from already strict mutating B1 --plan parsing only. Own undefined or foreign action/operation fields refuse; legacy synthetic controls may omit path, but native initial reader cannot.
Only a scope-owned accessor can return sealed plan path, SHA256 and operation. No caller selectors/providers and no generic capture export.
Initial native reader requires exact Owner approve action, approve operation, write consent, live three TTY and no existing approval selector. Renew/partial phases are excluded.
Read contained canonical-parent regular NOFOLLOW bounded plan file. Preserve exact pathname identity, descriptor identity and bytes; re-open original pathname after native capture and compare.
Use strict duplicate-key-refusing JSON, closed packaged schema, exact canonical JCS plus LF bytes and SHA256 matching sealed plan-sha256. Original argv SHA remains a distinct binding.
Re-run unchanged fixed native source capture with plan selection and compare exact canonical plan bytes. Actual source/index/parents/remote advertisement/B5 checks remain active.
Freeze complete effect recipe/output bounds before activating any Owner writer. This bridge itself permits no writes or mutation tokens.
counterexamples: Forged caller path, SHA, selectors or projection cannot replace sealed controls.
Wrong role/action/operation, approval-present initial attempt, renewal, missing write or TTY refuse.
Absolute/dot/backslash/foreign path, symlink parent or leaf and unsupported link count refuse according to frozen path contract.
Malformed/duplicate-key JSON, extra keys, noncanonical bytes, missing LF or trailing bytes refuse.
Forged selection, manifest digest, effect recipe or public evidence labels refuse actual recapture.
Plan pathname swap or in-place content change during capture refuses, even if original descriptor still points to old bytes.
Actual index, source, HEAD, MERGE_HEAD, package, policy or publication drift refuses.
qualification: Design review only; no implemented or installed initial-approval qualification claimed.
